description: Defines the GestureConverter class which converts gesture structs into NotifyArgs and manages gesture handling logic for input events in Android.

classes.name: GestureConverter
classes.description: Converts gesture structs into NotifyArgs and manages gesture-based input events.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current state of the GestureConverter.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the gesture state and returns a list of NotifyArgs.

methods.name: populateMotionRanges
methods.description: Populates motion range information for the input device.

methods.name: handleGesture
methods.description: Main method to handle a gesture event and produce NotifyArgs.

methods.name: handleMultiFingerSwipeLift
methods.description: Handles lifting of fingers after a multi-finger swipe.
